blockingIssues.description: Re-learn can throw before replaceSourceData() when every tracked file is missing or unreadable, leaving stale source data in the index.
Cloudflare crawl still drops non-completed records without structured pageFailures, so per-page failures are not surfaced for that ingest path.
Crawl dedupe uses fragment-only normalization and can treat secret-query variants as distinct pages before storage redaction.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a note that timeout-sensitive subprocess regressions may need a standalone runner when bun test fixtures are flaky, rather than forcing all coverage through the default harness.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: learn-git-hardening used a skipped timeout regression in bun test and the reviewer noted the timeout fixture was flaky under the test harness.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a note that complex learn-web hardening may require implementation-first exploration before targeted offline fixtures become obvious, especially around crawl/provider interactions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: learn-web-hardening required inspecting and patching the crawl/provider paths before the regression tests were fully clear.
